summary: Spine data layer (spine.py) implemented: Spine.create/open/exists, register_schema (immutable versioned schemas), append_entry, read_entries, read_all. SpineError for all failure cases. _iter_records skips malformed/blank lines with log.warning.
decision_or_outcome: Record format: schema records have kind=schema, id, version, definition, ts. Entry records have kind=entry, schema (id@version key), ts, data. Schema immutability enforced: re-registering same id@version raises SpineError.
